mapper.select: SELECT al.id, al.approvalId, al.actorId, al.action, al.comment, al.createdAt, u.name AS actorName FROM approvallog al LEFT JOIN user u ON al.actorId = u.id WHERE al.approvalId = #{approvalId} ORDER BY al.createdAt ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approvallog (id, approvalId, actorId, action, comment) VALUES (UUID(), #{approvalId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{comment})
